description: For web browsers only. Copies the URL of the current page or of a link at the cursor to the clipboard and announces it. Both command gestures can be configured through NVDA's Input Gestures dialog. The Copy Link URL command can be turned off in settings. Copy Page URL may be unavailable in Edge when UIA browse mode is enabled; see the add-on help.
changelog: Clarified that the add-on is designed only for web browsers and documented the Copy Page URL limitation in Edge with UIA browse mode.
